caseNameFull: Ex parte: In the Matter of Hussein Lutfi Bey, Master of the Turkish Government Steamship Gul Djemal

opinions.text: Submitted January 14, 1921. Decided January 17, 1921. Motion for leave to file a petition for writs of prohibition and / or mandamus herein denied. Mr. John M. Woolsey for petitioner. Suggestions of the Spanish Ambassador on behalf of the Turkish or Ottoman Government submitted by Mr. Frank J. McConnell.
